description: A quiet Markdown live preview editor that expands only the elements your cursor touches
config.previewColorScheme: Base colors of the preview (background, text, selection, cursor, line numbers, and so on). With a VS Code high contrast theme, VS Code's colors are always used regardless of this setting.
config.previewColorScheme.theme.descript: Uses the colors of the VS Code theme.
config.previewColorScheme.auto.descripti: Light with a light VS Code theme, and Dark with a dark one.
config.previewColorScheme.light.descript: Uses light colors made from the preview color.
config.previewColorScheme.dark.descripti: Uses dark colors made from the preview color.
config.colorCustomizations: Overrides the colors of individual elements. Write `"[green]": { ... }` to override only for that color (see the README).
config.rightMargin: Adds a margin on the right side of the editor as wide as the one on the left.
